summary: Object reset paired with a virtual release. When the secondary object a2 is present and holds a releaseable resource at a2+0x20, repeatedly call ArithmeticComparison_0f90(a2) while the reference count at a2+0x14 is positive, zero that reference count, invoke the resource object's virtual release method (vtable entry at offset 8, stdcall) and store its result into this+0, then clear the resource slot at a2+0x20.

local_names.this: owner object whose first field receives the virtual release result
local_names.a2: secondary object holding the resource to release
local_names.v3: releaseable resource object pointer read from a2+0x20

operations.description: Gate the whole reset on a2 being non-null and the resource slot *(a2 + 32) being non-null
While the reference count *(int*)(a2 + 20) is greater than 0, call ArithmeticComparison_0f90(a2) to drain outstanding references
v3 = *(a2 + 32) reads the resource object, then the reference count *(a2 + 20) is zeroed
Invoke the resource object's virtual release: stdcall through the vtable at *(v3) entry 8, and store its result into *this

Returns void; called from eight teardown/cleanup routines (RenderTargetCleanup, AudioResourceFree, SubBufferFree, AudioResourceCleanup, ConditionalFreeByFlag_28b0, ConditionalResourceCleanup_3310, sub_553370, ResourceTeardownWithStateArrayReset)
